title: Have you been to any of these places?

classification.question_topic: Asking if others recognize three recurring Mall World places (Whale Lake, Market Road, Mega Beach Hotel) and describing them.

meta.author_theory: Author believes they are 'for sure in Mall World' after seeing a TikTok image matching the bathrooms they see consistently.

position.relative_to: viewed from a road; pavilion on the left side when looking at the lake from the road

qualities.raw_description: Frozen type of lake; size can vary depending on where you’re looking at it from; sometimes has ice and waves; dark brown wooden pavilion on the left side if you’re looking at it from the road; stream runs alongside a road and goes into the lake from the left; mountains in the background; can go tubing down the stream and it winds down to the lake; lake is scary; lake has 2 giant whales (maybe more), 2 for sure; when you first see them when you get in the water they’re so big all you see is black.

position.relative_to: off of a super high scary highway

qualities.raw_description: Little narrow road you can sometimes drive down (off of the super high scary highway); most of the time you would be walking; rows in weird patterns of little shops and restaurants that look like shacks or little shipping containers with fabric awnings; there is a restaurant that is an actual building; when you go in you have to go up a few steps and then a ramp to the booths; normally a bit busy; red checkered table clothes; might be on the water; gives beach restaurant vibes.

locations.location_name: Market Road restaurant (building with steps + ramp)

position.relative_to: located on Market Road; interior requires going up a few steps then a ramp to booths

qualities.raw_description: Restaurant is an actual building; when you go in you have to go up a few steps and then a ramp to the booths; red checkered table cloths; normally a bit busy; might be on the water / beach restaurant vibes.

position.relative_to: dreamer is normally on the roof; roof either overlooks the ocean or turns into sand and has ocean access; pools/beach area is on top

qualities.raw_description: Normally on the roof; roof either overlooks the ocean, or turns into sand and has ocean access; hotel looks like two giant tower pillars with points at the top of both, connected by a shorter building; on top is the area where the pools and beach are; this is where you’ll see weird things above the water from.

locations.location_name: Mega Beach Hotel roof / top area

position.relative_to: on top of Mega Beach Hotel; overlooks ocean or becomes sand with ocean access; pools and beach area on top

qualities.raw_description: Roof/top area overlooks the ocean or turns into sand and has ocean access; pools and beach are on top; vantage point to see 'weird things above the water'.

connections.qualities: Entering the restaurant building from Market Road; inside requires going up a few steps then a ramp to booths.
Stream runs alongside a road and goes into the lake from the left; tubing down the stream winds down to the lake.
Roof/top area is part of the Mega Beach Hotel; pools and beach area are on top.

boundaries.description: Roof overlooks the ocean / has ocean access (roof turns into sand).

interactions.description: Tubing down a stream that winds down to Whale Lake; the dreamer does not want their tube to go into the lake.
Seeing two giant whales in the lake; when first seen in the water they are so big that all the dreamer sees is black.

entities_involved.description: Two giant whales; appear as 'black' due to size when first seen in the water.

interactions.description: Sometimes driving down Market Road off a super high scary highway; most of the time walking along rows of shops/restaurants.
Entering the restaurant building and going up a few steps and then a ramp to reach the booths.
From the Mega Beach Hotel roof/top area, seeing 'weird things above the water'.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post is framed as a question but contains detailed descriptions of three recurring locations. 'Bathrooms seen consistently' are mentioned but not described, so no bathroom location extracted.
